answer: The pulse test I would run is Bond forfeiture funding the harmed graders: slashed bonds paid to the graders who caught the fraud, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the whisper compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the lagoon of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
